result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a missing icon inside the circular notification/action button in the top-right header.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right corner of the header displays a red notification badge dot, but the icon itself (such as a notification bell or shopping bag) is missing, leaving an empty gray circle.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the icon asset or SVG renders properly inside the circular header button with sufficient contrast against the light gray background.
